snippet.title: Super Mario Party Jamboree – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition ＋ Jamboree TV – Overview Trailer
snippet.description:
The biggest party yet is about to get even bigger! Compete with new rulesets in Mario Party mode, play minigames using full-body movement and sound in Bowser Live, take an exhilarating ride on Carnival Coaster with mouse controls, and more! Super Mario Party Jamboree – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Jamboree TV launches on Nintendo Switch 2 July 24, 2025. 

Nintendo Switch 2 players who already have Super Mario Party Jamboree on Nintendo Switch can upgrade to Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Jamboree TV by purchasing the upgrade pack.

Pre-order the upgrade pack today: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/super-mario-party-jamboree-nintendo-switch-2-edition-plus-jamboree-tv-upgrade-pack-switch-2/?utm_source=SW-AAA&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=S1009-01&utm_id=S1009-01
